noDatabase.title: No database connected
noDatabase.body: Set DATABASE_URL and run pnpm db:migrate to see gifts, donors, volunteers and messages here.

dashboard.lead: Totals are all-time and net of refunds. Changes compare the last 30 days with the 30 days before.
dashboard.monthlyHint: Billed in the last 35 days, not cancelled
dashboard.empty: No gifts yet. They'll appear here once Stripe sends its first payment.

donations.lead: Every successful charge, newest first. Monthly gifts appear once per payment.

donors.lead: Everyone who's given, ordered by their latest gift.

volunteers.lead: Sign-ups from the Get involved page, newest first.

messages.lead: Messages from the contact form, newest first. Reply from your inbox; each one was also emailed to the group.

subscribers.lead: Newsletter sign-ups from the site footer. People count once they confirm by email. The CSV has confirmed subscribers only, each with their own unsubscribe link for your mailing tool.

campaigns.lead: Time-limited appeals with a goal, like a giving day. Share a campaign link and every gift made through it counts towards the goal. New campaigns, and changes to approved ones, need someone other than whoever asked to approve them.
campaigns.emptyBody: Create one with a goal and optional dates, then share its donate link. Gifts made through the link count towards the goal.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.body: No gifts have come in through this campaign yet. Its link will stop showing progress, though gifts made through it will still go through.

notices.created: Sent {name} for approval. It goes on the site once someone else approves it.
notices.resubmitted: Saved {name}. It’s waiting for approval again.
notices.approved: Approved {name}. It’s on the site now.
notices.changeRequested: Sent the changes to {name} for approval. It stays as it is on the site until someone else approves them.
notices.changeApproved: Approved the changes to {name}. They’re on the site now.

form.description: The link name goes in the campaign link, so keep it short. Dates are in UTC and only label the campaign; gifts made through the link count whenever they come in.
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, like giving-day-2026.
form.slugLocked: Gifts have come in through this link, so it can no longer change.

errors.slug: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes.
errors.endsBeforeStart: The end date can’t be before the start date.

form.changesNeedApproval: This campaign is approved, so your changes wait for someone else to approve them. Until then it stays as it is on the site.
form.changeWaiting: This shows the change that’s waiting for approval. Saving replaces it; saving it back to how the campaign is now withdraws it.

approval.waitingForOthers: Someone else who can approve campaigns has to approve it.
approval.rejectedBy: Turned down by {name}. Change it to ask again.
approval.rejectedWhy: Turned down by {name}: {reason}. Change it to ask again.
approval.changeWaitingForOthers: Your change is waiting for someone else to approve it.
approval.changeAskedBy: Change waiting for approval, asked by {name}

reviewDialog.title: Review {name}
reviewDialog.body: Check the details before it goes on the site. You can’t review a campaign you set up or changed.
reviewDialog.noteHint: Optional. Shown to whoever asked, so they can fix it.
reviewDialog.changeBody: Approving changes the campaign on the site to the new version. You can’t review a change you asked for.

funds.lead: The funds donors can choose from, in the order they see them. Changes reach the site straight away.
funds.lastOn: At least one fund has to stay on.

notices.turnedOn: {name} is showing on the site again.
notices.turnedOff: {name} is hidden from the site. Monthly gifts already set up keep going to it.

stories.lead: Stories about what gifts made possible. Write them in English, add Spanish and French when you can, and publish when they’re ready.
stories.emptyBody: Write one about something a gift paid for. It stays a draft, off the site, until you publish it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{title}”?
deleteDialog.body: It comes off the site straight away, along with its link. This can’t be undone.

errors.invalid: Something in the story wasn’t valid. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.slugTaken: Another story already uses that link name.
errors.notFound: That story no longer exists. Go back to the list.
errors.unknown: That didn’t save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.publishNotAllowed: Your role can save drafts but can’t change what’s on the site. Ask someone who can publish stories.

localeHint.source: Required. The Spanish and French pages show this version until they’re written.
localeHint.other: Optional. Leave every field empty to show the English version here, or fill in all of them.

form.title: Title
form.titleHint: The headline on the story page and its card.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Usually a first name only, as the person agreed to share it.
form.roleHint: Rank and job, like “Airman First Class, aircraft maintenance”.
form.summaryHint: One or two sentences for the story card and search results.
form.quoteHint: A line in their own words, shown when the story is on the home page.
form.bodyHint: Add images with the image button, or paste or drop them in. Select an image to resize it from its corners or describe it for screen readers.
form.slugHint: Goes in the story’s web address. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
form.fundHint: The story asks readers to give to this fund.
form.publishedOnHint: Shown on the story, and used to order the list.
form.publishNotAllowedHint: Your role can save drafts. Someone who can publish stories puts them on the site.
form.isFeaturedHint: Replaces the story featured now. With none featured, the newest is shown.
form.isSampleHint: Labels it as written to show the layout, not a real account.

errors.incomplete: Fill this in too, or clear this language’s other fields to show English.
errors.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes.

form.bodyHintNoImages: Images are off until Cloudinary is set up (CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME, CLOUDINARY_API_KEY and CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET).

link.label: Link address
link.invalid: Enter a web address, like https://example.org.

image.tooLarge: Images can be up to 5 MB.
image.type: Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
image.failed: The image didn’t upload. Try again.
image.altHint: What someone who can’t see the image needs to know. Leave empty if it’s only decoration.

unavailable: No database connected, so there is nothing to export.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your role doesn’t include this page. Ask someone who manages the team if you need it.

team.lead: Who can open the back office, what each role lets them do, and account security.
team.pendingSignIn: They’ll get an email with a link to confirm their address and choose a password. Roles that manage people or account security also set up two-step verification.
team.name: Name
team.emailHint: The address they’ll sign in with.
team.empty: No one has been added yet.
team.rolesLead: A role is a set of permissions. Built-in roles are fixed; add your own for a different mix. To keep duties apart, downloads, site settings, role changes and two-step resets stay in built-in roles, and a role that manages access can’t also see people’s details or change fundraising. There’s one SuperAdmin at a time. Anyone whose role can manage people or account security must use two-step verification.

errors.name: Enter their name.
errors.invalid: That change wasn’t valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.emailTaken: Someone with that email is already on the team. Change their role in the list instead.
errors.notFound: That person is no longer on the team. Reload the page.
errors.noDatabase: Connect a database to manage the team.
errors.alreadySetUp: They’ve already set up their account.
errors.noTwoFactor: They haven’t set up two-step verification, so there’s nothing to reset.
errors.self: You can’t do that to your own account. Your own security settings are in Settings → Security.
errors.lastSuperAdmin: The SuperAdmin can’t be locked, turned off or given another role. They can hand SuperAdmin to someone else first.
errors.outranked: They have access you don’t, so you can’t change their account. Ask a SuperAdmin.
errors.roleNotAllowed: That role has permissions you don’t have, so you can’t give it out or change it.
errors.roleNameTaken: There’s already a role with that name.
errors.roleBuiltIn: Built-in roles can’t be changed or deleted. Add a role of your own instead.
errors.roleSuperAdmin: SuperAdmin always has every permission and can’t be changed.
errors.roleInUse: People still have this role. Give them another role first.
errors.ownRole: You can’t change your own role’s permissions. Ask someone else who manages roles.
errors.dutyConflict: This role mixes duties that should be split between people: managing access, and seeing people’s details or changing fundraising.
errors.superAdminTaken: There’s already a SuperAdmin. They can hand the role over from the Team page.
errors.rateLimited: Too many wrong passwords. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.notSuperAdmin: Only the SuperAdmin can hand the role over.
errors.memberLocked: This person’s account is locked. Unlock it before making them SuperAdmin.

team.inviteSent: Added {name} as {role}. We emailed them a link to set up their account.
team.inviteNotSent: Added {name} as {role}, but the email couldn’t be sent. Send them this link yourself. It works once and expires in 7 days:
team.resentNotSent: The email couldn’t be sent. Send {name} this link yourself:

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}’s access?
removeDialog.body: {name} will be signed out straight away and won’t be able to sign in. You can restore their access later.

notices.twoFactorReset: Reset {name}’s two-step verification. They’ll set it up again next time they sign in.
notices.locked: Locked {name}’s account. They’ve been signed out everywhere.
notices.superAdminTransferred: {name} is now the SuperAdmin, and you’re {role}.

resetDialog.title: Reset {name}’s two-step verification?
resetDialog.body: Use this if {name} lost their phone or can’t get to their email. Their second step and recovery codes stop working and they’re signed out everywhere. If their role needs two-step verification, they’ll set it up again next time they sign in. We’ll email them to say you did this.

team.roleHint: You can only give out roles whose permissions you have yourself.

lockDialog.title: Lock {name}’s account?
lockDialog.body: Use this if their password or email might be in someone else’s hands. {name} is signed out on every device at once and can’t sign in until someone unlocks the account. We’ll email them to say you did this.
lockDialog.reasonHint: Kept with the lock and in the audit log, e.g. “Laptop stolen 12 May”.

unlockDialog.title: Unlock {name}’s account?
unlockDialog.body: {name} will be able to sign in again. If their password may have been seen by someone else, ask them to reset it first.

signOutDialog.title: Sign {name} out everywhere?
signOutDialog.body: {name} is signed out on every device. They can sign straight back in with their password and second step.

roles.members: {count, plural, =0 {No one} one {# person} other {# people}}

form.name: Name
form.descriptionHint: One line on what this role is for.
form.permissionsHint: Choosing anything in an area also lets them see it. You can only give permissions you have yourself.
form.securityHint: People with any of these must use two-step verification.
form.viewHint: Built-in roles can’t be changed. Add a role of your own for a different mix.
form.dutiesNote: To keep duties apart, some permissions are only in built-in roles, and a role can’t both manage access and see people’s details or change fundraising.

builtInOnly.platform: Only SuperAdmin and IdentityManager change site settings.
builtInOnly.export: Downloads of whole lists are only in built-in roles.
builtInOnly.roles: Only built-in roles can change what roles allow.
builtInOnly.takeover: Only built-in roles can reset someone’s two-step verification.

conflicts.accessAndData: Can’t be in the same role as managing access and seeing people’s details.
conflicts.accessAndFundraising: Can’t be in the same role as managing access and changing fundraising.

form.notYours: You don’t have this permission, so you can’t give it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the {role} role?
deleteDialog.body: This can’t be undone. No one has this role at the moment.

handOverDialog.title: Make {name} the SuperAdmin?
handOverDialog.body: There’s one SuperAdmin at a time, so you’ll hand it to {name} and take another role. Only they will then be able to hand it on.
handOverDialog.yourRoleHint: What you’ll be able to do afterwards.

permissions.donors:read: See donors and their contact details
permissions.stories:publish: Publish stories, and change live ones
permissions.campaigns:approve: Approve or turn down new campaigns and changes (not their own)

auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in isn’t set up yet. The site needs a database and AUTH_SECRET.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter the email you sign in with and we’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {email} belongs to someone on the team, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in an hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: You’ll be signed out everywhere and can sign in again with the new password.

verify.title: Welcome, {name}
verify.lead: Your email is confirmed once you choose a password. Next you’ll set up an authenticator app.

linkInvalid.title: This link doesn’t work
linkInvalid.body: It may have expired or already been used. Ask someone who manages the team to send a new invite, or reset your password if you’ve set one before.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryLead: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each one works once.
twoFactor.lostAccess: Lost your phone, your email and your recovery codes? Ask someone who manages the team to reset your two-step verification.
twoFactor.emailLead: We emailed a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.

setup.title: Set up two-step verification
setup.lead: Choose how you’ll confirm it’s you after your password.
setup.step1: Scan this code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Authy.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.manual: Can’t scan it? Enter this key instead:
setup.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.codesLead: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager. You won’t see them again.
setup.required: Your role can manage people or account security, so it needs two-step verification.
setup.optional: Recommended: the back office holds donors’ details. You can change this later in Settings.

choose.authenticatorHint: A code from an app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Authy. Works offline.
choose.emailHint: A code sent to {email} each time you sign in.
choose.skipHint: Sign in with just your password.

setup.emailStep: We’ll email a 6-digit code to {email} to check it reaches you.
setup.emailSent: We sent a code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
setup.passwordStep: Enter your current password to change how you sign in.

errors.recoveryCode: Enter a recovery code, like abcde-fghjk.
errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.invalid: That email and password don’t match.
errors.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Wait 15 minutes, or reset your password.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.expired: That took too long or had too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
errors.wrongCode: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again.
errors.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used.
errors.verificationFailed: We couldn’t confirm you’re not a bot. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.timeZone: Choose a time zone from the list.
errors.suspended: This account is locked. Ask someone who manages the team to unlock it.
errors.twoFactorRequired: Your role needs two-step verification, so you can switch methods but not turn it off.
errors.emailUnavailable: We can’t send emails right now. Use an authenticator app or a recovery code instead.
errors.codeCooldown: We just sent a code. Wait a minute before asking for another.

invite.subject: Set up your {orgName} back office account
invite.heading: Hi {name}
invite.added: {invitedBy} added you to the {orgName} back office as {role}.
invite.instructions: Confirm your email and choose a password with the button below. The link works once and expires in 7 days.
invite.footer: If you weren’t expecting this, you can ignore it.

reset.subject: Reset your back office password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.instructions: Someone asked to reset the password for {email}. If it was you, choose a new one with the button below. The link works once and expires in an hour.
reset.footer: If you didn’t ask for this, ignore it. Your password hasn’t changed.

security.notYou: If this wasn’t you, change your password now and tell someone who manages the team.
security.footer: You get these emails because security alerts are on in your back office settings.

signedIn.subject: New sign-in to the {orgName} back office
signedIn.heading: You signed in
signedIn.body: Your back office account was just signed in to.

recoveryCodeUsed.subject: A recovery code was used on your {orgName} account
recoveryCodeUsed.heading: A recovery code was used
recoveryCodeUsed.body: Someone signed in to your back office account with one of your recovery codes. Each code works once, so make new ones if you’re running low.

passwordChanged.subject: Your {orgName} back office password changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your back office account was changed from Settings. Your other devices were signed out.

passwordReset.subject: Your {orgName} back office password was reset
passwordReset.heading: Your password was reset
passwordReset.body: The password for your back office account was reset with an emailed link. Every device was signed out.

twoFactorEnabled.subject: Two-step verification is on for your {orgName} account
twoFactorEnabled.heading: Two-step verification is on
twoFactorEnabled.body: Two-step verification was turned on for your back office account. You’ll need it each time you sign in.

recoveryCodesRegenerated.subject: New recovery codes for your {orgName} account
recoveryCodesRegenerated.heading: You made new recovery codes
recoveryCodesRegenerated.body: New recovery codes were made for your back office account. The old ones no longer work.

security.notExpected: If you didn’t expect this, tell someone who manages the team straight away.
security.footerAlways: We always send this email, because someone else changed your account’s security.

twoFactorReset.subject: Two-step verification was reset on your {orgName} account
twoFactorReset.heading: Your two-step verification was reset
twoFactorReset.body: {ownerName} reset two-step verification on your back office account. Your second step and recovery codes no longer work, and you were signed out everywhere. If your role needs it, you’ll set it up again next time you sign in.

twoFactorChanged.subject: You changed how you sign in to {orgName}
twoFactorChanged.heading: Your two-step verification changed
twoFactorChanged.body: Your back office account now uses a different second step, with new recovery codes. The old ones no longer work.

twoFactorTurnedOff.subject: Two-step verification is off for your {orgName} account
twoFactorTurnedOff.heading: Two-step verification is off
twoFactorTurnedOff.body: Your back office account now signs in with just your password.

accountLocked.subject: Your {orgName} back office account was locked
accountLocked.heading: Your account was locked
accountLocked.body: {ownerName} locked your back office account, for example because your password may be known to someone else. You were signed out everywhere and can’t sign in until it’s unlocked.

accountUnlocked.subject: Your {orgName} back office account was unlocked
accountUnlocked.heading: Your account was unlocked
accountUnlocked.body: {ownerName} unlocked your back office account, so you can sign in again.

superAdminReceived.subject: You’re now the SuperAdmin for {orgName}
superAdminReceived.heading: You’re now the SuperAdmin
superAdminReceived.body: {ownerName} handed SuperAdmin to you, so you can now do everything in the back office. There’s one SuperAdmin at a time; you can hand it on from the Team page.

superAdminHandedOver.subject: You handed over SuperAdmin for {orgName}
superAdminHandedOver.heading: You handed over SuperAdmin
superAdminHandedOver.body: {memberName} is now the SuperAdmin, and your role is {role}.

code.subject: {code} is your {orgName} sign-in code
code.heading: Your sign-in code
code.expiry: It works for 10 minutes, and only on the device where you asked for it.
code.footer: If you didn’t try to sign in, someone may know your password. Change it now in Settings → Security.

settings.lead: Your account, security and preferences, plus settings for the whole site.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: Ask someone who manages the team if your email needs to change.

password.title: Password
password.lead: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {You have no recovery codes left. Make new ones now.} one {# recovery code left.} other {# recovery codes left.}}
twoFactor.lead: A second step after your password, so a stolen password isn’t enough to get in.

current.none: Off. You sign in with just your password.

twoFactor.required: Your role needs two-step verification. You can switch methods but not turn it off.
twoFactor.switchAuthenticator: Switch to a new authenticator app
twoFactor.turnOffBody: You’ll sign in with just your password, and your recovery codes stop working.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.others: {count, plural, =0 {You aren’t signed in anywhere else.} one {You’re also signed in on # other device.} other {You’re also signed in on # other devices.}}

errors.invalid: Some settings weren’t valid. Check them and try again.
errors.unavailable: Settings can’t be saved without a database.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.emailOff: Email isn’t set up on this site yet (RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM), so nothing will be sent until it is.

notifyVolunteers.label: New volunteer sign-ups
notifyVolunteers.hint: A copy of each volunteer form as it comes in. The team inbox gets these too.

notifyMessages.label: New contact messages
notifyMessages.hint: A copy of each contact form message. Reply to the email to answer the sender.

notifySecurity.label: Security alerts
notifySecurity.hint: When you sign in, change your password, or use or replace recovery codes. We recommend keeping this on.

preferences.title: Display
preferences.lead: How the back office looks for you. Other people’s settings aren’t affected.
preferences.timeZoneHint: Dates and times in tables and the audit log use this zone.
preferences.pageSizeHint: How many rows tables show before you page through them.

platform.title: Platform
platform.lead: Settings for the whole site and everyone on the team. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
platform.inboxHintFallback: Volunteer sign-ups and contact messages are emailed here. Leave it empty to use {email} from ORG_NOTIFY_EMAIL.
platform.inboxHintNone: Volunteer sign-ups and contact messages are emailed here. If it’s empty they’re only saved in the back office and sent to anyone who turned those notifications on.
platform.donationsPausedHint: Visitors can’t start a new gift; the donate form says giving is unavailable. Monthly gifts already set up keep going.
platform.sessionHoursHint: Applies from each person’s next sign-in.
platform.someone: someone no longer on the team

audit.lead: Who did what in the back office: sign-ins, team, campaign, fund, story and settings changes, and data downloads. Newest first.

auth.sign_in_locked: Tried to sign in during a wrong-password lock
auth.invite_accepted: Accepted invite and set a password
auth.password_reset: Reset password from an emailed link
auth.sign_in_while_locked: Tried to sign in to a locked account

team.updated_from_cli: Added or updated from the command line

fund.turned_on: Showed a fund on the site
fund.turned_off: Hid a fund from the site

table.empty: Nothing matches. Try a different search or filter.

errors.invalid: Something in that change wasn’t valid. Check it and try again.
errors.slugTaken: Another campaign already uses that link name.
errors.notFound: That campaign no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.hasGifts: Gifts have come in through this campaign, so its link can’t change and it can’t be deleted.
errors.lastFund: At least one fund has to stay on.
errors.unknown: That didn’t save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.ownCampaign: You asked for this, so someone else has to approve it.
errors.notPending: This campaign isn’t waiting for approval any more. Refresh the page.
errors.reviewOutdated: This campaign changed after you opened it. Refresh the page and review it again.
